documents.title: Post-Diagnosis Adherence to the Mediterranean Diet and Cancer Recurrence and Fatigue Outcomes in Cancer Survivors, with Emphasis on Colorectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

effects.comparison_verbatim: higher post-diagnosis MD adherence vs. lower adherence
effects.quote: For recurrence, higher post-diagnosis MD adherence was associated with a lower hazard of recurrence or cancer-specific mortality (HR = 0.83; 95% CI: 0.70–0.99; I 2 = 49%).
